dedupeText: soulful duotone album cover layout duotone didone typography vertical text gold and black textured paper portrait overlay r b aesthetic the vertical side bar anchors the left edge creating a structural frame the central duotone image provides a warm focal point against the cool toned textured background high contrast serif typography creates a rhythmic balance between the top and bottom sections combine high contrast serif typography with duotone horizontal image band and vertical side bar text on a textured paper background

retrievalProfile.description: A sophisticated music-focused layout featuring a duotone central portrait framed by high-contrast serif typography and a vertical side-bar element.
triggerTerms: duotone portrait with vertical side text
gold and black album cover layout
textured paper background with centered photo

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tier vertical composition featuring a central duotone image strip, flanked by a textured light-gray background at the top and bottom, with a distinctive vertical text bar on the left side.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical side-bar anchors the left edge, creating a structural frame.
The central duotone image provides a warm focal point against the cool-toned textured background.
High-contrast serif typography creates a rhythmic balance between the top and bottom sections.
coreInvariants: Duotone color treatment for the central image
Subtle paper-like texture across the background
Vertical text orientation on the left margin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A medium-close portrait is centered horizontally within a horizontal band that spans the width of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold serif name at the top right acts as the primary entry point for the eye.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top-right text, down through the central image, to the bottom text, while the vertical bar on the left provides a secondary vertical path.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the top and bottom textured regions prevents the layout from feeling cluttered.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Light gray with a subtle paper texture for the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the primary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold/ochre for the duotone image filter and the left vertical bar.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between black text and light background; low saturation within the gold duotone image.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical text on the left is rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise and scaled to fill the height of the bar.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic font family pairing using different scales and orientations of the same high-contrast serif.
graphicDevices: Vertical color block on the left

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme contrast and bold presence of the display text.
Provides the elegant, high-fashion look typical of soul/R&B covers.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a light gray background with a subtle distressed paper texture. Add a horizontal band in the center containing a gold-toned duotone portrait of a man with a microphone. Add a solid gold vertical bar on the far left edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, high-contrast Didone serif text in black at the top right and bottom center. Add large, rotated vertical text on the left gold bar using a knockout effect to reveal the background texture.

verificationChecks: Is the central image a gold duotone?
Is the left text vertically oriented?
Does the typography have high stroke contrast?

adjustableVariables: Width of the left vertical bar
Height of the central image band
Specific hue of the gold duotone
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and song title
The exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the vertical text is legible and correctly rotated.
Ensure the duotone effect doesn't lose subject detail.
Verify the paper texture is subtle and doesn't interfere with text legibility.
Confirm the three-tier horizontal structure is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [High-Contrast Serif Typography] with [Duotone Horizontal Image Band] and [Vertical Side-Bar Text] on a [Textured Paper Background].
